en:
Since you're here, you wish to learn 
more about anthropology, yes?

Yes, I would like to learn more,
if that's alright with you.

Of course. I will speak of it for as 
long as you wish to hear of it.

Perhaps we should sit somewhere 
for our discussion.

<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to sit in the dining hall
and drink some tea while we talked.

You seem to be looking at me with a
strange expression. Is something wrong?

Ah, well, you're always wearing
that mask, Kiyo...

I was just wondering how
you would drink tea.

Ah, this.
I take it off at times like these...

<CLT=cltMIND>So he *does* take it off sometimes. That makes
sense, or else he couldn't eat or drink.

...and I replace it with 
a mask for meals.
A mask for meals!?
That is correct.

I have one for bathing, sleeping, 
and even exercising.
<CLT=cltMIND>So he has a variety...
If you will excuse me...

<CLT=cltMIND>After excusing himself, Korekiyo turned his back
to me and began changing masks.

<CLT=cltMIND>He *could* just take it off...
He doesn't have to have so many kinds.
<CLT=cltMIND>Why so particular about that...?
Thank you for waiting, Shuichi.

Huh?
Did you change your mask?
I did. This is the one for meals.
<CLT=cltMIND>...It looks exactly the same.

So I will proceed to enjoy 
this tea now.
O-Okay...

This tea has a nice scent. I usually 
prefer green tea, but this is wonderful.

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo looked to be in a trance as
he brought the cup of tea to his lips.

<CLT=cltMIND>But won't it just spill
on the mask...?

Aaah... A mellow flavor that makes 
itself familiar to the tongue.

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh? The mask isn't wet.
Did he pour it in the slit?
<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't even see him do it.

Ah, and we have cookies as well.
They look delicious.
<CLT=cltMIND>Cookies...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'll definitely get to see him
take off his mask to eat that.

<CLT=cltMIND>I held my breath and watched as
Korekiyo brought the cookie to his lips...
What the...?

<CLT=cltMIND>What happened!?
The cookie just disappeared...
What is the matter?

It... The cookie, it just...
disappeared...

Well yes... Because I put it 
into my mouth.

<CLT=cltMIND>But it didn't look like
you ate it at all!

Kehehe...you're wondering how I ate it,
aren't you?

If you are vexed by such trivial things, 
then your world is still very small.

I will open up your world through 
anthropology...if you so desire.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Korekiyo's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltMIND>After sharing some tea,
I returned to my room.
